description.zh: 把 Git 用顺手、用安全：按改动写规范的提交说明，按提交类型生成更新日志，统计提交和热点文件，清理长期不用的分支；提交错了、删错分支、合并冲突、推送被拒时一步步安全恢复。脚本只读，修改仓库的命令由你确认执行。
description.en: Makes Git smooth and safe: conventional commit messages, changelogs grouped by type, commit and hotspot stats, stale branch cleanup, and step-by-step recovery from bad commits, deleted branches, conflicts and rejected pushes. Read-only scripts; you run any changes.

welcome_message.zh: 把 git status 或报错发给我，或者告诉我想做什么
welcome_message.en: Send me git status or the error, or tell me what you need

prompt.zh: 我改了 ___，帮我写一条规范的提交说明。
prompt.en: I changed ___. Write a conventional commit message.

prompt.zh: 整理从 ___ 到现在的更新日志。
prompt.en: Write the changelog from ___ to now.

prompt.zh: 我执行了 ___，现在 ___，怎么恢复？
prompt.en: I ran ___ and now ___. How do I recover?

prompt.zh: 合并 ___ 时冲突了，冲突内容是 ___，该怎么处理？
prompt.en: Merging ___ conflicted with ___. How do I resolve it?

prompt.zh: 帮我看看仓库里哪些分支可以删。
prompt.en: Which branches in my repo can be deleted?

prompt.zh: 我们团队 ___ 人，___（发版方式），用什么分支模型合适？
prompt.en: Our team has ___ people and ships ___. Which branching model fits?

zh: 每周五「17:00」统计本周提交和改动最频繁的文件
每次发版前「15:00」生成上一个标签以来的更新日志
每月 1 日「10:00」列出已合并和超过 90 天未动的分支
每天「18:00」提醒推送本地未推送的提交
每季度第一天「10:00」汇总提交类型分布，检查规范执行情况
每周一「09:00」检查主分支是否有未关联需求号的提交
en: Every Friday at 17:00, summarize this week's commits and hotspot files
Before each release at 15:00, generate the changelog since the last tag
On the 1st of each month at 10:00, list merged and 90-day-stale branches
Every day at 18:00, remind to push unpushed local commits
On the first day of each quarter at 10:00, review commit type distribution
Every Monday at 09:00, check main for commits without issue references
